_meta.description: Tier 3: Commercial consolidation (RJ 217 / IAS 27 / IFRS 10). Ten new schemas (ConsolidationGroup, GroupEntity, IntercompanyRelation, ConsolidationPeriod, EliminationEntry, TranslationAdjustment, MinorityInterest, Goodwill, ConsolidatedBalance, ConsolidatedIncomeStatement) enabling Dutch MKB holding companies to consolidate multi-entity financial statements. All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-aggregations) per ADR-031. No ConsolidationCalculator.php / EliminationMatcher.php services. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-schema preconditions (status-transition gates, accountant-review presence, balance-sheet equation, minority split) delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ConsolidationGuard. Reuses the existing Administration register (per-entiteit GL) and the Nextcloud user directory for executor/reviewer FKs. A person is an NC entity, never an invented schema (ADR-022).

ConsolidationGroup.title: Consolidation Group
ConsolidationGroup.description: Definition of a consolidation circle (moeder + dochters) per RJ 217 / IFRS 10. Holds the reporting framework, reporting currency, uniform fiscal-year end and default consolidation method. Wettelijke basis: BW 2:406. One per groepsstructuur; a ConsolidationPeriod runs a measurement for a specific period against this group.

parentAdministrationId.description: FK to the moeder Administration (existing Administration register): the holding whose GL anchors the group.
parentAdministrationId.title: Parent Administration ID

reportingCurrency.description: ISO 4217 reporting currency for the consolidated statements (RJ 122 / IAS 21).
reportingCurrency.title: Reporting Currency

reportingFramework.description: Consolidation grondslag: RJ 217 (Nederlandse commerciële norm) or IFRS 10. Gates goodwill treatment (design D5).
reportingFramework.title: Reporting Framework

fiscalYearEnd.description: Uniform boekjaar-einde across all groepsentiteiten; divergent fiscal years require harmonisation.
fiscalYearEnd.title: Fiscal Year End

defaultConsolidationMethod.description: Default consolidation method applied to entities that do not override it (RJ 217 §4-7 / IFRS 10 §19, design D2).
defaultConsolidationMethod.title: Default Consolidation Method

notes.description: Free-text remarks, e.g. exemption rationale (art. 2:403/407/408 BW).
notes.title: Notes

state.description: Lifecycle state of the group definition.
state.title: State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Group structure and entities being defined.

active.label: Active
active.description: Group is live; consolidation periods may be run against it.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Group dissolved or superseded; retained for history.

activate.label: Activate group
activate.description: Activate once the parent and at least one entity are defined.

reopen.label: Reopen group
reopen.description: Return an inactive group to draft for restructuring.

GroupEntity.title: Group Entity
GroupEntity.description: A deelneming within a consolidation group. Maps an Administration to the group with its eigendomspercentage, stem-percentage, consolidation method, eerste-consolidatie-datum and functionele valuta. Drives the per-entity column in the pre-elimination werkpapier (design D10) and the minority-interest split (design D6).

administrationId.description: FK to the entity's Administration (existing Administration register): the source GL for aggregation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

entityType.description: Role of the entity within the group (RJ 217 §3-7).
entityType.title: Entity Type

votingPercentage.description: Stem-percentage; may diverge from ownership via prioriteitsaandelen. Defaults to ownership when omitted.
votingPercentage.title: Voting Percentage

consolidationMethod.description: Per-entity consolidation method (RJ 217 §4-7 / IFRS 10/11/28, design D2).
consolidationMethod.title: Consolidation Method

firstConsolidationDate.description: Date the entity entered the consolidation circle; aggregation skips pre-acquisition periods.
firstConsolidationDate.title: First Consolidation Date

lastConsolidationDate.description: Date the entity left the circle on desinvestering; CTA recycles to P&L on exit.
lastConsolidationDate.title: Last Consolidation Date

functionalCurrency.description: ISO 4217 functionele valuta of the entity; divergence from reportingCurrency triggers currency translation.
functionalCurrency.title: Functional Currency

state.description: Lifecycle state of the entity membership.
state.title: State

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Entity being mapped into the group.

desinvested.label: Desinvested
desinvested.description: Sold/exited; cumulative CTA recycled to P&L.

activate.label: Activate entity
activate.description: Activate once method and ownership are consistent.

desinvest.label: Desinvest entity
desinvest.description: Mark the entity as sold; recycle cumulative CTA.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Group Entity is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

IntercompanyRelation.title: Intercompany Relation
IntercompanyRelation.description: Mapping of an internal trade relationship between two group entities for elimination matching. The "wegwijzer" that tells the eliminatie-engine which debtor account in entity A corresponds to which creditor account in entity B, with the matching tolerance.

debtorEntityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity carrying the debtor/sales side.
debtorEntityId.title: Debtor Entity ID

creditorEntityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity carrying the creditor/purchase side.
creditorEntityId.title: Creditor Entity ID

transactionType.description: Type of intercompany transaction the relation eliminates.
transactionType.title: Transaction Type

defaultEliminationAccount.description: GL account number on the debtor side to eliminate (e.g. 8200 Intercompany sales).
defaultEliminationAccount.title: Default Elimination Account

defaultCounterpartyAccount.description: GL account number on the creditor side to offset (e.g. 7200 Intercompany purchases).
defaultCounterpartyAccount.title: Default Counterparty Account

matchingTolerance.description: Override matching tolerance for this relation. Defaults to €10 absolute / 0.5% relative (design D3).
matchingTolerance.title: Matching Tolerance

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Intercompany Relation is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ConsolidationPeriod.title: Consolidation Period
ConsolidationPeriod.description: A consolidation run for a specific period. Container for the elimination werkpapier; carries the workflow state (open → eliminationPhase → review → closed → archived), the executor, computed elimination totals and the exception queue of out-of-tolerance mismatches (design D3). Snapshot is immutable once closed.

periodEnd.description: End of the consolidated period; balansposten translate at this slotkoers.
periodEnd.title: Period End

executor.description: Nextcloud user id of the user who initiated the consolidation (FK to the NC user directory: a person is an NC entity, never an invented schema).
executor.title: Executor

executionTimestamp.description: When the consolidation run was initiated.
executionTimestamp.title: Execution Timestamp

totalEliminationCount.description: Computed count of elimination entries in this period (aggregation).
totalEliminationCount.title: Total Elimination Count

totalEliminationAmount.description: Computed total elimination amount (debit side) in reporting currency (aggregation).
totalEliminationAmount.title: Total Elimination Amount

mismatches.description: Exception queue for out-of-tolerance intercompany differences (design D3).

intercompanyRelationId.description: FK to the IntercompanyRelation that mismatched.
intercompanyRelationId.title: Intercompany Relation ID

debtorAmount.title: Debtor Amount
debtorAmount.description: The debtor amount as a numeric value.

creditorAmount.title: Creditor Amount
creditorAmount.description: The creditor amount as a numeric value.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of this record.

resolvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id that resolved the mismatch.
resolvedBy.title: Resolved By

resolvedAt.title: Resolved At
resolvedAt.description: The date and time for resolved at.

mismatches.title: Mismatches

totalEliminationAmount.description: totalEliminationAmount = SUM(EliminationEntry.lines[].debit) for approved eliminations of this period.

open.label: Open
open.description: Group setup complete; source administrations closed; pre-elimination aggregation runs.

eliminationPhase.label: Elimination phase
eliminationPhase.description: Pre-elimination werkpapier generated; intercompany matching runs; mismatches queued; elimination entries generated.

review.label: Review
review.description: Accountant reviews each elimination entry (approve/reject); balances must reconcile.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Snapshot immutably archived; no further changes.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Moved to long-term retention (7+ years, art. 2:404-405 BW).

startElimination.label: Start elimination phase
startElimination.description: Begin matching once every active entity's source GL is confirmed complete.

submitForReview.label: Submit for review
submitForReview.description: Submit once at least one elimination exists and no mismatch is left pending.

close.label: Close consolidation
close.description: Close once every elimination entry is approved (none pending/rejected) and the accountant signs off.

archive.label: Archive consolidation
archive.description: Move the closed snapshot to long-term retention.

reopenToElimination.label: Return to elimination
reopenToElimination.description: Return to elimination phase to correct rejected entries.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Consolidation Period is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

EliminationEntry.title: Elimination Entry
EliminationEntry.description: An individual elimination booking within a consolidation period. Carries debit/credit lines per GL account, the source entities/transactions for drill-down, the auto-generated flag and the full accountant-review audit trail (who/when/why, design D7). Immutable once the period closes; a reversal is a new entry, never an overwrite.

lines.description: Debit/credit entries per GL account; debit total must equal credit total.
lines.title: Lines

sourceEntities.description: GroupEntity ids involved in the elimination.
sourceEntities.title: Source Entities

sourceTransactions.description: Links to the original journalEntry ids in the source administrations for drill-down.
sourceTransactions.title: Source Transactions

autoGenerated.description: True when system-generated by the matching engine; false when manually entered (design D7).
autoGenerated.title: Auto Generated

reviewedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the accountant who reviewed (FK to NC user directory).
reviewedBy.title: Reviewed By

pending.label: Awaiting review
pending.description: Generated or entered; awaiting accountant review.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Accountant approved; flows into the consolidated output and group GL.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Accountant rejected with rationale; backed out of the consolidation.

approve.label: Approve elimination
approve.description: Approve once a reviewer is recorded.

reject.label: Reject elimination
reject.description: Reject once a reviewer and rationale are recorded.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Elimination Entry is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

TranslationAdjustment.title: Translation Adjustment
TranslationAdjustment.description: Currency revaluation (CTA) for a foreign-currency entity per the current-rate method (RJ 122 / IAS 21). Records the functional- and reporting-currency amounts and the isolated CTA component posted to OCI/eigen vermogen: never to the P&L (design D4).

translationMethod.description: Rate applied: current (balansposten), average (V&W), historical (eigen vermogen) per RJ 122 / IAS 21 (design D4).
translationMethod.title: Translation Method

amountInFunctionalCurrency.description: Amount in the entity's functional currency.
amountInFunctionalCurrency.title: Amount In Functional Currency

amountInReportingCurrency.description: Translated amount in the group reporting currency.
amountInReportingCurrency.title: Amount In Reporting Currency

ctaComponent.description: CTA portion posted to OCI/eigen vermogen; non-recycling until desinvestering.
ctaComponent.title: Cta Component

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Translation Adjustment is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

MinorityInterest.title: Minority Interest
MinorityInterest.description: Non-controlling interest tracking per entity with ownership <100%. Records the third-party percentage and rolls the opening balance + period result share − dividend forward to the closing balance, presented separately under geconsolideerd eigen vermogen as "Aandeel derden" (RJ 217 §8 / IFRS 10 §B95-B96, design D6).

entityId.description: FK to the GroupEntity with ownership <100%.
entityId.title: Entity ID

thirdPartyPercentage.description: Percentage held by third parties = 100 − ownershipPercentage.
thirdPartyPercentage.title: Third Party Percentage

periodResultShare.description: Computed minority share of current-period profit (negative = loss) (aggregation).
periodResultShare.title: Period Result Share

closingBalance.description: closingBalance = openingBalance + periodResultShare − dividendToMinority (design D6). Declarative per ADR-031: no MinorityInterestCalculator.php.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Minority Interest is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

Goodwill.title: Goodwill
Goodwill.description: Acquisition goodwill/badwill with amortisation schedule. On first consolidation of an acquired subsidiary, purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired = goodwill (positive) or badwill (negative). Amortisation method is gated by the group's reportingFramework: RJ linear (10/20yr) vs IFRS impairment-test (design D5).

fairValueNetAssetsAcquired.description: Fair value of identifiable net assets acquired (RJ 216 / IFRS 3).
fairValueNetAssetsAcquired.title: Fair Value Net Assets Acquired

goodwillAmount.description: Computed: purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired (positive = goodwill, negative = badwill) (calculation).
goodwillAmount.title: Goodwill Amount

amortizationMethod.description: Treatment gated by ConsolidationGroup.reportingFramework: RJ linear amortisation or IFRS annual impairment (design D5).
amortizationMethod.title: Amortization Method

residualValue.description: Residual value at end of amortisation.
residualValue.title: Residual Value

impairmentCorrections.description: IFRS impairment-test results (IAS 36) when reportingFramework = IFRS10.

testDate.title: Test Date
testDate.description: The date and time for test date.

recoverableAmount.title: Recoverable Amount
recoverableAmount.description: The recoverable amount as a numeric value.

impairmentLoss.title: Impairment Loss
impairmentLoss.description: The numeric value for impairment loss.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: The date and time for rationale.

impairmentCorrections.title: Impairment Corrections

goodwillAmount.description: goodwillAmount = purchasePrice − fairValueNetAssetsAcquired (positive = goodwill, negative = badwill) per RJ 216 / IFRS 3 (design D5). Declarative per ADR-031: no GoodwillCalculator.php.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Goodwill is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ConsolidatedBalance.title: Consolidated Balance
ConsolidatedBalance.description: Output object with aggregated + eliminated balance totals per RGS-rapportageregel, with comparative prior-year columns. The balance-sheet equation totalAssets = totalLiabilities + totalEquity must hold (design D10, validated by ConsolidationGuard).

lines.description: One row per RGS-rapportageregel with pre/post-elimination and comparative figures (design D10).

preEliminationTotal.title: Pre Elimination Total
preEliminationTotal.description: The pre elimination total as a numeric value.

eliminationAdjustments.description: EliminationEntry line ids applied to this row.
eliminationAdjustments.title: Elimination Adjustments

postEliminationTotal.title: Post Elimination Total
postEliminationTotal.description: The post elimination total as a numeric value.

comparativePriorYear.title: Comparative Prior Year
comparativePriorYear.description: The numeric value for comparative prior year.

variancePercent.title: Variance Percent
variancePercent.description: The numeric value for variance percent.

lines.title: Lines

totalEquity.description: Computed total equity incl. minority interest + CTA (aggregation).
totalEquity.title: Total Equity

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Generated; pre/post-elimination figures may still change.

published.label: Published
published.description: Deposited with KvK / issued for management reporting.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Consolidated Balance is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ConsolidatedIncomeStatement.title: Consolidated Income Statement
ConsolidatedIncomeStatement.description: Output object with consolidated V&W per RGS-rapportageregel, split between parent shareholders and minority interest, with comparative prior-year columns. The split netProfitTotal = attributedToParent + attributedToMinority must hold (validated by ConsolidationGuard).

lines.description: One row per RGS-rapportageregel with pre/post-elimination and split figures (design D10).

preEliminationTotal.title: Pre Elimination Total
preEliminationTotal.description: The pre elimination total as a numeric value.

eliminationAdjustments.title: Elimination Adjustments
eliminationAdjustments.description: A list of elimination adjustments entries.

postEliminationTotal.title: Post Elimination Total
postEliminationTotal.description: The post elimination total as a numeric value.

attributedToParent.title: Attributed To Parent
attributedToParent.description: The numeric value for attributed to parent.

attributedToMinority.title: Attributed To Minority
attributedToMinority.description: The numeric value for attributed to minority.

comparativePriorYear.title: Comparative Prior Year
comparativePriorYear.description: The numeric value for comparative prior year.

lines.title: Lines

netProfitAttributedToParent.description: Computed net profit attributable to parent shareholders.
netProfitAttributedToParent.title: Net Profit Attributed To Parent

netProfitAttributedToMinority.description: Computed net profit attributable to minority interest.
netProfitAttributedToMinority.title: Net Profit Attributed To Minority

finalize.label: Finalise income statement
finalize.description: Finalise once netProfit = parent + minority split.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Consolidated Income Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

objects.notes: Voorbeeld-consolidatiegroep: Holding BV (moeder) + Werk BV (100%-dochter). Operators pas dit aan per eigen entiteit.
Werk BV verkoopt aan Holding BV; 8200 Intercompany sales ↔ 7200 Intercompany purchases.
